question: At which causal destination positions do the confirmed auxiliary heads L11H1/H3 and L15H5 add to the already confirmed L9H1/H4 converter?

frozen_design.population: The same 27 jointly capable v10 rows used for the zero-fit five-head confirmation.
frozen_design.conditioning: L9H1/H4 are clamped to native base at every causal destination in every arm. Each auxiliary arm additionally clamps L11H1/H3 and L15H5 only at one of five exhaustive destination groups.
frozen_design.controls: All auxiliary destinations must replay the five-head minus core marginal; prefix response deltas and effects must be exactly zero; native self-clamp must be exact.

predictions.pred_a_authority_partition_self_clamp_fi: Hashes, population, exhaustive partitions, exact self-clamp, finite values, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_all_destinations_replay_confirmed: The all-destination auxiliary arm exactly replays the confirmed five-head minus L9H1/H4 behavior and Q8 marginal.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_one_proper_destination_i: At least one proper destination carries at least 50% of auxiliary behavior and 50% of auxiliary Q8 norm in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_causal_prefix_destination_is_zero: Prefix raw selected-head response delta, behavior, and Q8 removal are zero within 1e-6.
predictions.pred_e_destination_program_is_compressiv: At most two proper destination groups jointly account by singleton sum for at least 75% of the all-destination auxiliary behavior in both panels.

decision: Screen licenses source-by-pattern/value/interaction decomposition only at the material destinations. Null retains full causal destinations and forbids premature value-weight compilation.
